verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents resolving alerts with a case decision such as 'no risk detected', which covers clearing a false positive. Cases can be remediated via the web app or API, and a case audit-trail endpoint provides the audit record. Nothing in the evidence shows a resolved decision can be reopened or overridden, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented reopen/override of a closed case decision, evidence that overrides are captured in the audit trail, hands-on or independent corroboration.
